formNote: Mojidata IDS: ⿱中心. The Shuowen: 忠，敬也。从心，中聲 — “reverence: from heart, with 中 as phonetic.” Reading it as “a centred heart” treats the phonetic as meaning.
summary: Loyalty, but first doing one’s utmost for others: Zengzi said the Master’s whole way was 忠 and 恕, wholeheartedness and fellow-feeling. Later it hardened into loyalty to a ruler.
placement: On the falling side of the fold, facing 孝 across it. (Placement is a design choice, not a claim.)

oc.note: † Baracus, from general knowledge; not yet checked against B–S 2014.
